label: Small, synthetic package-metadata corpus derived from one real triage case; no DUT vulnerability or exploitability claim

provenance.basis: The recorded official Debian tracker lists the bookworm lldpd version 1.0.16-1+deb12u1 as fixed. The earlier 1.0.16-1 is the unpatched comparison case.

cases.policy_context: Synthetic verified-baseline flag; not a verified switch artifact

limitations: One CVE, one package, two versions and two advisory-feed scopes do not measure all-CVE recall or precision.
Package metadata matching does not prove vulnerable code is running, reachable or exploitable.
A Debian revision suffix is only an uncertainty signal; it does not prove that a security patch is present.
Expected matches are checked against the recorded scanner/database revision at run time; future advisory changes may require review.
